meta.name: pre-publish-review
meta.description: Nuclear-grade 16-agent pre-publish release gate. Runs /get-unpublished-changes to detect all changes since last npm release, spawns up to 10 ultrabrain agents for deep per-change analysis, invokes /review-work (5 agents) for holistic review, and 1 oracle for overall release synthesis. Runs ONLY when the user explicitly asks for a pre-publish review — a plain publish/release request MUST NOT trigger this; /publish ships directly. Triggers: 'pre-publish review', 'review before publish', 'release review', 'pre-release review', 'ready to publish?', 'can I publish?', 'pre-publish', 'safe to publish', 'publishing review', 'pre-publish check'.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会先找出距上次 npm 发布以来的所有改动，派最多 10 个智能体逐组分析、5 个智能体做整体审查、1 个总览智能体做发布总结，最后给出版本号建议、破坏性变更、变更日志草稿和风险评级。
howto.when: 仅当你明确要求做发布前审查时触发，例如说“发布前审查”“pre-publish review”“检查能否发布”等；普通发布请求不会触发。

say.text: 请对当前改动做发布前审查。
say.note: 会启动 16 个智能体分三层检查。

say.text: 运行 pre-publish review，检查是否可以发布。
say.note: 普通发布不会触发，必须带审查指令。

say.text: 帮我做发布前检查，重点看有没有破坏性变更。
say.note: 产出版本号建议和风险评级。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude finds all changes since the last npm release, spawns up to 10 agents for per-group analysis, 5 for holistic review, and 1 oracle for release synthesis, then outputs version bump suggestions, breaking changes, draft changelog, and risk rating.
howto.when_en: Triggers only when you explicitly ask for a pre-publish review, e.g. "pre-publish review" or "check before publish". A plain publish request will not trigger it.

say_en.text: Please do a pre-publish review of the current changes.
Run pre-publish review and tell me if I can publish.
say_en.note: Plain publish won't trigger; must ask for review.

say_en.text: Do a pre-publish check, focus on breaking changes.
say_en.note: Outputs version bump suggestions and risk rating.
